sources.title: Entry 25 conditional candidate assessment
sources.citation: Existing 2 October 2026 synthesis of Puech pp. 59–60, Sion pp. 61–64/Plan 5 and the source-plan repeat and phase audit. No independent observation.

pillar.note: Rock-cut dividing pillar reported on p. 63; its cutting date is unresolved.

terrace_association.note: A pillar does not decide the retained platform/terrace reading.

northern_member.reference_frame: Sion Plan 5 published north arrow, true/grid/magnetic convention unspecified
northern_member.note: Right aperture is northern after orienting the plan; page-left/page-right are not compass directions.

cave_east_aspect.note: Published eastern-cliff aspect; no exact azimuth follows.

both_openings_east_aspect.note: Cave-level cliff aspect does not resolve the stricter individual-mouth interpretation. Chord normals are not surveyed passage bearings.

northern_opening_width_reported.uncertainty: Published rounding/measurement uncertainty unspecified; not an ancient threshold reconstruction.

northern_opening_chord_width.reference_frame: Sion Plan 5, 626 × 541 crop pixels, origin top-left; [548,386]–[502,400]

uncertainty.kind: non-statistical raster sensitivity; scan distortion unquantified

northern_chord_normal_proxy.reference_frame: clockwise from unspecified published north arrow; aperture chord normal

uncertainty.kind: not a surveyed true/passage bearing; source north convention and scan distortion unquantified

true_individual_mouth_bearings.note: No edition angular tolerance; do not substitute source-plan proxies.

ancient_arrangement_phase.note: No published sealed pillar, mouth, wall or threshold contacts. Survey coins and arrowhead basket numbers do not date the arrangement.

published_use_reconstruction.value: first half of second century to first half of first century BCE
published_use_reconstruction.note: Excavator use reconstruction and concealment interpretation; not a demonstrated entrance or wall construction phase.

northern_threshold_elevation.note: Neither current nor ancient northern threshold level is registered.

horizontal_path_direction.note: No chosen horizontal axis or path is supplied by the inspected source.

ancient_traversable_connection.note: Continuous 2D route depicted; clearance, level changes and ancient traversal unknown. Not a mandatory entry predicate.

pillar.note: Feig p. 85: internal southwest pillar, natural below and rock-cut above.

two_exterior_openings.note: Inspected text describes an opening in the singular; Plan 1 does not establish a pair. This is not proof that a second ancient opening was absent.

cave_east_aspect.note: Reported eastward enlargement toward the cliff does not establish facing direction.

ancient_arrangement_phase.note: Disturbed later deposits and upper-fill coins do not date pillar cutting, entrance enlargement or northern threshold.

northern_threshold_elevation.note: Earlier/later living surfaces and upper-fill coin height cannot supply the northern threshold datum.

pillar.note: Thick rock pillar divides northern/southern units; worked state and dimensions unspecified.

northern_member.note: Northern/southern units named in p. [15] description; no registered mouth points.

cave_east_aspect.note: Eastern cliff slope and east-facing openings toward Dead Sea reported.

both_openings_east_aspect.note: Qualitative published aspect, not an exact surveyed bearing.

northern_opening_width_reported.note: 35 m length/4 m mean width concern the northern cavity, not the mouth.

ancient_arrangement_phase.note: Period-compatible ceramics do not date pillar construction, mouths or threshold. Cave A/B cannot be equated with northern/southern units.

northern_threshold_elevation.note: Several metres of general deposits are not threshold-specific excavation depth.

ancient_traversable_connection.note: Internal communication is not described; not a mandatory entry predicate.

limits.candidate_selection: Three previously examined comparators, not a regional census or a ranked sample.
limits.geometry: No surveyed individual-mouth world coordinates, true bearings or deposit points.
limits.confirmation: All source material was already exposed. No unused prediction is certified.
limits.claims: Reported feature compatibility, ancient feature phase and possible target geometry are separate. No deposit existence, survival, rarity or identification confidence is scored.
